scope: External datasets used by GridIQ that are not part of the OIC2-bundled evidence. Committed files are verified by scripts/verify_manifests.py; fetched files are checked after scripts/fetch_data.sh.

files.note: Filtered live extract fetched 2026-09-13. E2 primary topology.
Demand allocation points for E2. Uniform allocation across snapped substations is a labelled assumption.

files.source: World Bank / energydata.info — Botswana Electricity Transmission Network (BPA 2006 + Eskom Dec 2006)
files.note: 2006-vintage. Captures ~40% of the current 400/220/132 kV network; used as a cross-check and for cross-border/planned corridors, not as the primary topology.

files.source: Zenodo / Loughborough University Climate Compatible Growth (OSeMOSYS/TEMBA)
files.note: Botswana-specific techno-economic assumptions (T&D and plant costs, 2015-2050). Modelling assumptions, not BPC procurement data.
